notes.title: Update to v1.1.1 "Unprogressive fixes
notes.content:
Game update: Japan time "Tuesday, November 24
/-------------------------------------------------- modification------------------------------------------------/

Stage 26 was not clearable, so it has been corrected.
The map of stage 26 has been modified, messages have been changed, and the specifications of some gimmicks have been changed in accordance with this modification.

notes.title: Update to v1.1.0 "Some Features + Important Notice"
notes.content:
Game update: Wednesday, October 28 (Japan time)
/------------------------------------------------- new additions----------------------------------------------/

It is now possible to pause the game by pressing the P button on the keyboard or the START button on the controller during gameplay. Also, while paused, you can now choose to "continue", "start from the beginning", "title", or "end" the game.

/---------------------------------------------- important notice: ---------------------------------------------/

The way to save the game data is different from this version.

You must temporarily save a file called [SaveData.dat] in the [Game Data] folder where the game data is saved, update to version 1.1.0, and then overwrite the [SaveData.dat] file. dat] file to its original location. If you don't follow this procedure, your game's save data will be lost. This method is only for this update and will not be necessary for future updates.
